summary_en: FY3/28 targets: ROE 8%+ and operating margin 8%. Long-term targets: ROE 15%+ and operating margin 15%. FY3/26 ROE reached 9.8% vs estimated cost-of-capital ~10%. Interim period (FY3/24–FY3/25) saw losses; company targets early dividend reinstatement and productivity expansion in semiconductor packaging inspection equipment.
title_en: Update on Measures to Realize Management with Awareness of Cost of Capital and Share Price
translation_en_brief:
inspec Inc. issued an update to its cost-of-capital and share-price awareness roadmap announced on 22 July 2025. The company reports that FY3/26 (year ended April 2026) ROE reached 9.8%, approximately in line with its estimated shareholder cost of capital (approximately 10%). However, the prior five-year period saw losses in FY3/24 and FY3/25 due to new business R&D and business exits, preventing consistent outperformance of cost of capital. Current PBR stands at 3.5x, reflecting investor confidence in the company's long-term growth prospects.

The company sets specific quantitative targets: by FY3/28, operating margin of 8% and ROE of 8%+; longer term, operating margin of 15% and ROE of 15%+. Near-term actions include advancing semiconductor packaging inspection equipment development (especially for AI-related devices), expanding production capacity, targeting early dividend reinstatement while balancing retained earnings, and strengthening investor relations via expanded seminars and regular management meetings with institutional investors.
